title: Mavericks of Business Central: Different career paths & opportunities

chapters.title: Microsoft talent programs and knowledge building
Best practices - theoretical and practical knowledge
Career exploration paths - consultant, developer, areas of focus
Flexibility in career trajectory and technical roles

features.name: Microsoft talent programs
features.description: Microsoft offers talent programs that enable people to build knowledge and career in Business Central by implementing best practices.

features.name: Combination of theoretical and practical knowledge
features.description: Success in Business Central requires both theoretical knowledge and practical experience, which is best achieved by working with experienced people.
caveats: Beginning consultants and developers often lack practical knowledge without mentorship

features.name: Multiple career paths in Business Central
features.description: Starting in Business Central allows exploration of multiple career areas including consultant, sales, finance, project manager, or technical developer roles with code-level work.
